items.title: The Language of Instruction: Genre and Generative AI
items.summary: The article posits instruction‑fine‑tuned language models as a new genre, the instructional‑conversational genre, blending prior human‑model dialogue.
items.whyItMatters: Understanding this genre helps tech‑savvy readers anticipate how instruction‑based AI shapes future interactions.

items.title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
items.summary: SceneBloom generates realistic, varied indoor 3D layouts for embodied AI, combining language guidance with visual generative models and geometric reasoning.
items.whyItMatters: It enables more robust training of agents in diverse, simulation-ready environments, improving real-world applicability.

items.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
items.summary: RobustRLlib unifies robust reinforcement learning algorithms into a single library and benchmark, improving reusability and clarifying empirical performance limits.
items.whyItMatters: It streamlines research and deployment of reliable RL models for real‑world systems facing unpredictable shifts.

items.title: DexPort: A Hand-Held Skill Interface for Dexterous Hand Data Collection
items.summary: DexPort introduces a handheld interface that captures human hand movements for dexterous robot manipulation, simplifying data collection without full robot setup.
items.whyItMatters: It speeds up training data acquisition, reducing operator effort and improving robot learning efficiency.

items.title: Flownomaly: Single-Step Conditional-Mean Recovery for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
items.summary: Flownomaly recovers normal images in a frozen DINOv2 feature space using a velocity field for few-shot anomaly detection.
items.whyItMatters: It offers a flexible, exemplar-free method that better preserves normality and avoids anomaly leakage.

items.title: Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox
items.summary: The article introduces Foyer, a self-hosted inbox agent that uses typed decision models, compares it to classical and generative baselines, and presents a measurement protocol for evaluating email routing decisions.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it offers a measurable, privacy‑preserving way to improve personal email automation.

items.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: The article explains how aligning rounding behavior between inference and training stabilizes reinforcement learning for large language models.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers care because consistent rounding reduces off‑policy errors, improving training reliability and model performance.

items.title: Beyond Discrete Tokens: Preserving Numerical Continuity in Medical Vision-Language Models
items.summary: The article introduces HAD-VLM, a hybrid vision‑language model that predicts continuous ultrasound measurements while generating text prompts.
items.whyItMatters: It enables precise, real‑time quantitative imaging for clinicians, improving diagnostic accuracy and workflow efficiency.

items.title: Monetizing Intelligence: Advertising and Subscription Design on LLM Platforms
items.summary: The paper analyzes how an LLM platform balances ad revenue, response quality, and subscription pricing to maximize profit while managing user value.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers should know how ad strategies affect AI service quality and pricing models.

items.title: Knowledge Distillation across Item and Code Spaces for Parallel Generative Recommendation
items.summary: The paper proposes knowledge distillation between item and code spaces to improve generative recommendation using semantic IDs and soft label distributions.
items.whyItMatters: It offers a way to enhance recommendation accuracy by leveraging richer supervision for tech-savvy developers building AI-driven recommendation systems.

items.title: If at First You Don't Succeed, Backtrack: Lightweight Recovery for Frozen VLAs
items.summary: Backtrack offers a lightweight failure detection and recovery method for frozen Vision‑Language‑Action models in robotics.
items.whyItMatters: It lets robots self‑correct without costly retraining, boosting reliability in real‑world manipulation tasks.

items.title: Learning Positive Linear Combinations of ReLUs in Fully Polynomial Time
items.summary: The paper presents a fully polynomial-time algorithm for PAC-learning positive linear combinations of k ReLU units over ℝ^d under Gaussian distribution with L₂ loss.
items.whyItMatters: It enables efficient training of shallow ReLU ensembles, improving scalability for high-dimensional, noise-tolerant machine learning.

items.title: Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
items.summary: Despite advances in multilingual text representations, effective dense retrieval for Persian remains constrained by the limited availability of language-specific training resources and compact embedding models. items.title: ZENO: Nonlinear filtering with Zakai Equation Neural Operators
items.summary: State inference and parameter learning for nonlinear filters is a core computation for scientific machine learning with varied applications in engineering and neuroscience. items.title: Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding for Mixed Natural Language and Structured Symbolic Corpora
items.summary: Modern language models rely on subwording tokenization to define the discrete units of input processing, typically using methods like Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) that treat whitespace as a fixed semantic boundary. items.title: SemantEq: Faithful Bidirectional Equivalence of Formal Statements
items.summary: Statement autoformalization translates mathematics from natural language into a proof assistant such as Lean 4, and models now do it at scale. As provers get stronger, the burden of correctness shifts from the proof to the statement, that is, to whether the formal statement faithfully translates its source. Given a trusted reference formalization, the natural test is logical equivalence, and it…

items.title: A Tutorial on Physics Constrained Machine Learning for Hybrid Modeling, Optimization, and Control
items.summary: Physics-constrained machine learning (PCML) integrates domain knowledge, first-principles, and physical constraints into AI/ML models. In this work, we present a step-by-step tutorial of a modular PCML framework, KKT-HardNet, and illustrate how it could be used for hybrid modeling, process simulation, optimization and model predictive control in a single platform. items.title: Recommender regret for improving regularised RL estimation with bandits and MCTS
items.summary: Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms rely on estimators, like Monte Carlo tree search or one-step look-ahead, to provide policy, value, or Q-value estimates in training and inference. However, existing bandit-based estimation frameworks evaluate sampling efficiency, not the quality of estimates. items.title: LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
items.summary: Location encoders map geographic coordinates to high-dimensional descriptors through contrastive alignment with paired Earth Observation imagery. items.title: Green Code or Costly Code? Evaluating the Energy Costs of Iterative LLM-Based Code Optimizations
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to optimize code for performance. This practice often assumes that improvements in execution speed naturally translate into overall lower energy consumption.
